copy.chinese_support: 手作豆腐 · 当日现制

required_process_evidence: physically credible hands or tools when present

arm_A_direct_reference.raw_photo_brief: Use the approved Shanyeji poster only as a direct visual reference for editorial quality and overall design ambition. Create a truthful 3:4 handmade-tofu workshop photograph with visible process, credible soy/cloth/water materials, natural depth and restrained retouching, plus a substantial scene-derived quiet region for later typography. Do not copy the original title contours, exact layout, palette, symbols or surface tokens. Do not render final text, pseudo-text, labels, badges or detached text panels.

photo_type_space.primary_photo_field: tofu-making process may occupy central and lower zones with natural near/mid/far depth
photo_type_space.reserved_type_region: one continuous scene-derived quiet region spanning approximately 40-50% of frame width and 16-24% of frame height; exact location decided from the generated photograph without artificial banner
photo_type_space.support_region: smaller adjacent quiet pocket that remains visually subordinate

display_title_plan_for_figma.construction: Start from Noto Sans SC Black outlines and create an original bold two-glyph display lockup through moderate optical correction and custom vector editing only; do not use the capsule's predeclared structural-display rules as instructions.
display_title_plan_for_figma.legibility: Both 豆 and 坊 must remain immediately readable at first glance.
display_title_plan_for_figma.surface: clean solid vector; no brush calligraphy, fake ink, generic distress or copied source erosion
display_title_plan_for_figma.placement: Place the lockup in the strongest natural quiet region of the selected A photograph; maintain dominant first-read authority without a detached panel.
display_title_plan_for_figma.support_copy: HANDMADE TOFU and 手作豆腐 · 当日现制 use editable Inter Medium and Noto Sans SC Medium, aligned to the chosen title axis and clearly subordinate.

arm_B_distilled.raw_photo_brief: Create a native 3:4 photo-only handmade-tofu process field using the approved reference plus the V1.1 candidate only for transferable hierarchy, counter-mass, tonal-space, density, depth and semantic-role relationships. Show truthful soybeans, grinding, pressing, cloth, curd and water with physically credible non-wok hand contact. Concentrate the active process primarily lower/right or central and create a genuine upper-left/transverse tonal/frequency pocket for later typography through staging, crop, depth and light rather than a panel or gradient. Use pale soy, stone, cloth and water neutrals with cool shadows. Do not render final typography, pseudo-copy, badges, motifs or copied source identity.

photo_type_space.primary_photo_field: lower-right or central tofu process sequence
photo_type_space.primary_type_region: upper-left or transverse scene-derived quiet zone, target normalized x 0.07-0.72 and y 0.10-0.29 with flexibility for real photographic structure
photo_type_space.support_region: separate process-created quiet pocket below or alongside the title, target y 0.28-0.40

display_title_plan_for_figma.construction: Start from the same Noto Sans SC Black outlines, then rebuild 豆坊 as one broad planar authored non-brush two-glyph display mass with intentional counter/negative-space topology and controlled planar cuts that remain character-correct.

glyph_behavior.豆: broader and more horizontal, using the top and central strokes to establish a stable planar base while preserving the lower structural distinction
glyph_behavior.坊: slightly taller and optically heavier on the right, with the 土 and 方 relationship clarified before any custom cuts are introduced

display_title_plan_for_figma.group_behavior: The pair reads as one transverse first-read object and counterbalances the lower/central tofu-process mass; exact source-title contours and word silhouette must not be copied.
display_title_plan_for_figma.surface: solid vector with planar geometry; no brush, ink, erosion or distress shortcut
display_title_plan_for_figma.placement: upper-left/transverse relation to the selected B photograph; edge approach or controlled crop is allowed only if character recognition remains immediate
display_title_plan_for_figma.support_copy: HANDMADE TOFU and 手作豆腐 · 当日现制 remain second/third read in the separate process-created quiet pocket, using editable Inter Medium and Noto Sans SC Medium.

figma_frame.safe_margin: 6% frame width minimum unless intentional title crop is logged
figma_frame.title_support_relationship: support copy must not overlap peak process detail
